targets.query: from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vus" and r.environment == "${environment}" and r.run_id == "${run_id}")

from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_reqs" and r.environment == "${environment}" and r.run_id == "${run_id}") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: sum)

from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r.environment == "${environment}" and r.run_id == "${run_id}") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: column))

from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_failed" and r.environment == "${environment}" and r.run_id == "${run_id}") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean)

from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "custom_article_read_duration_ms" and r.environment == "${environment}" and r.run_id == "${run_id}") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: column))

from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "custom_article_write_duration_ms" and r.environment == "${environment}" and r.run_id == "${run_id}") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: column))

from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "custom_business_errors_total" and r.environment == "${environment}" and r.run_id == "${run_id}") |> sum()
